title: NUBURU Appoints Gianluca Trezza as CEO of TEKNE and Provides Commercial Update
summary: Experienced defense executive to lead industrial execution and development of electronic warfare and special vehicle opportunities across Italian and international markets DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) ("NUBURU" or the "Company"), a dual-use Defense & Security platform company, today announced the appointment of Gianluca Trezza as Chief Executive Officer and General Manager of TEKNE S.p.A. ("Tekne"), effective October 26, 2026. The appointment follows NUBURU’s acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne on October 15, 2026, and places industrial execution and commercial development at the center of the next phase of integration. Gianluca Trezza Trezza brings more than three decades of experience across Italian institutions and the international defense industry. Following service in Italy’s Guardia di Finanza, where he attained the rank of Major, he held senior leadership roles at ELT Group, a major player in EW and defense industry, across the Middle East, Asia-Pacific and global business development. His experience spans electronic warfare, cyber intelligence, C4ISR and international industrial partnerships. His priorities will include aligning customer commitments with procurement and production, strengthening program controls, engaging the relevant Italian authorities on potential program reactivation, and developing Tekne’s electronic-warfare, special-vehicle and defense-mobility businesses. This mandate supports NUBURU’s strategy of combining Tekne’s industrial capabilities with the group’s photonics, software and systems-integration capabilities, subject to technical qualification, customer requirements and applicable approvals. “With Tekne now part of NUBURU, our priority is execution,” said Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-CEO of NUBURU. “Gianluca brings the sector knowledge and international experience to connect customer opportunities with industrial delivery. *Experienced defense executive to lead industrial execution and development of electronic warfare and special vehicle opportunities across Italian and international markets*


DENVER--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) ("NUBURU" or the "Company"), a dual-use Defense & Security platform company, today announced the appointment of Gianluca Trezza as Chief Executive Officer and General Manager of TEKNE S.p.A. ("Tekne"), effective October 26, 2026. The appointment follows NUBURU’s acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne on October 15, 2026, and places industrial execution and commercial development at the center of the next phase of integration.


Gianluca Trezza


Trezza brings more than three decades of experience across Italian institutions and the international defense industry. Following service in Italy’s Guardia di Finanza, where he attained the rank of Major, he held senior leadership roles at ELT Group, a major player in EW and defense industry, across the Middle East, Asia-Pacific and global business development. His experience spans electronic warfare, cyber intelligence, C4ISR and international industrial partnerships.


His priorities will include aligning customer commitments with procurement and production, strengthening program controls, engaging the relevant Italian authorities on potential program reactivation, and developing Tekne’s electronic-warfare, special-vehicle and defense-mobility businesses. This mandate supports NUBURU’s strategy of combining Tekne’s industrial capabilities with the group’s photonics, software and systems-integration capabilities, subject to technical qualification, customer requirements and applicable approvals.


*“With Tekne now part of NUBURU, our priority is execution,”* said Alessandro Zamboni, Executive Chairman and Co-CEO of NUBURU. *“Gianluca brings the sector knowledge and international experience to connect customer opportunities with industrial delivery. We intend to demonstrate progress through confirmed awards, reliable deliveries and the conversion of those deliveries into revenue.”*


*“With Golden Power authorization secured and NUBURU’s acquisition completed, I am fully committed to working with the relevant Italian government authorities and contracting bodies to pursue the resumption of selected eligible programs and opportunities placed on hold while the authorization process was pending,”* said Gianluca Trezza. *“We will address the contractual and technical requirements of each program and align delivery plans with customers and suppliers. Any resumption or new award remains subject to the relevant authorities’ decisions and applicable procurement procedures.”*

**Revenue generation through 2031**


The planning scenario concentrates existing-program revenue in 2027–2028, with remaining deliveries through 2029. Selected defense programs assume restart in December 2026, with initial revenue from other MoD procedures in March 2027 and Flyer in April 2027. These programs require reinstatement or new awards, production funding and customer acceptance. Growth through 2031 also depends on securing further new business.


The Company intends to build on Tekne’s customer base across Italy, the United States, NATO and allied markets where authorized, extending equipment deliveries through maintenance, upgrades, software and lifecycle support. New integrated offerings remain subject to qualification and customer adoption. NUBURU aims to integrate Tekne into a comprehensive Defense & Security platform, operating as a long-term industrial group with shared engineering, coordinated manufacturing and integrated customer solutions across electronic warfare, special vehicles, photonics, software and lifecycle services.


**About NUBURU Inc**


NUBURU, Inc. (NYSE American: BURU) is developing a dual-use Defense & Security platform combining electronic warfare and defense mobility, laser and photonics engineering, operational-resilience software and AI-assisted orchestration, and advanced manufacturing and support. Its strategy is to integrate operating businesses and developing technologies into solutions for defense, security, critical-infrastructure and industrial customers. NUBURU’s operating capabilities include Tekne’s special-vehicle and electronic-system engineering, Lyocon’s laser expertise and Orbit’s operational-resilience software. Integrated mission packages and technologies under development remain subject to validation and applicable approvals.
